**Working:**

- Pipe A fills the tank at a rate of 1/4 tank per hour.
- Pipe B drains the tank at a rate of 1/6 tank per hour.

Since they work against each other, the net rate when both are open is:

$$\text{Net rate} = \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{6}$$

Find a common denominator (12):

$$\frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{12}, \quad \frac{1}{6} = \frac{2}{12}$$

$$\text{Net rate} = \frac{3}{12} - \frac{2}{12} = \frac{1}{12} \text{ tank per hour}$$

**Time to fill the tank:**

$$\text{Time} = \frac{1 \text{ tank}}{\frac{1}{12} \text{ tank/hour}} = 12 \text{ hours}$$

ANSWER: 12
